subject: Acme procurement: next steps & security gating
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Acme procurement: next steps & security gating

Thanks again for the call earlier today, Alice (and Tom on the security side). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

- Recap: Acme is evaluating Redwood for inference across a pilot (2-3 models) with potential to scale into production.
- Procurement path: you mentioned AP/PO is preferred for production purchases; card is ok for a short pilot if that speeds things up.
- Security gating: SOC 2 report, executed DPA, and a short security questionnaire are required before procurement approval. Tom indicated the SOC 2 and DPA are the big gating items.

Requested next steps (from Acme):
1) Confirm preferred billing flow (PO via AP system vs card for pilot).
2) Share any specific procurement contacts or PO template to ensure our billing team hits the right fields.
3) Tom (security) to share security questionnaire or prioritize sections we should complete first.

What I can do from Redwood:
- I attached our Security Overview and a draft DPA for your legal team to review. I can get the SOC 2 report link and a redacted report for procurement/legal (see Box link below).
- If helpful, we can accept a short pilot on card while PO is routed for production — keeps momentum.
- Rishi (cc) is our commercial/legal partner and can help with MSA redlines and procurement coordination.

Proposed timeline: pilot kick-off in ~2 weeks if card accepted, PO execution within 4-6 weeks for production depending on Acme timelines.

Links/attachments included below. Please let me know the preferred path and any procurement contacts.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Overview_v2.pdf; Redwood_DPA_Acme_signed_stub.pdf
Box SOC2 link: https://redwood.box.com/s/soc2-report-acme
From: Alice Kim <alice.kim@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Herrera <tom.herrera@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2027 16:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme procurement: next steps & security gating

Thanks Marissa — great summary. A few clarifications from procurement/security: 

- Billing: For any production purchase Acme uses PO via SAP; AP requires fields for PO#, remittance address, and tax ID. For pilots under $10k we typically allow card.
- Timeline: PO processing is handled by our AP team; typical turnaround is 3-4 weeks once we have the DPA and SOC 2 evidence.
- Security questionnaire: I attached the questionnaire (small file, sending via separate SFTP per Tom's request) — Tom, can you confirm which sections you want prioritized?

Procurement contact: 
Rebecca Lin (AP team) <rebecca.lin@acme.com> — please include Rebecca on invoicing/PO templates.

We'll review the DPA and security overview and get back with any redlines.

Best,
Alice Kim
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Corp
alice.kim@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Kim <alice.kim@acme.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme procurement: next steps & security gating

Thanks Alice — and hi Rebecca, great to meet you. 

Rebecca — copied here are the three practical options we can pursue so your AP team can pick what's easiest: 

1) PO (preferred for production): Redwood issues invoice to the billing contact once PO is received. We can accept PO via email to billing@redwood.com or via your AP portal (we'll fill required fields).
2) Marketplace (AWS Marketplace): If Acme prefers marketplace billing, we support SaaS contracts through AWS Marketplace (this can simplify procurement for some orgs; fees and discounts vary).
3) Card for pilot: Quickest for a 2-4 week pilot < $10k while PO progress is underway.

Attachments I've uploaded for your review: 
- Redwood_Security_Overview_v2.pdf (attached)
- Redwood_DPA_Acme_signed_stub.pdf (attached)
- Acme_Security_Questionnaire_Filled.xlsx (I started filling the questionnaire — please review and let me know where you need more detail)

Rishi — if we can get the redlined DPA back from Acme, our legal team will triage. If Rebecca confirms a PO template, we'll make sure invoices include the correct fields.

Next steps: 
- Rebecca: confirm PO field requirements or marketplace preference.
- Tom: prioritise top 5 questionnaire items to unblock procurement if possible.
- Alice: share any required contract clauses that your legal team will insist on (data residency, audit rights, etc).

Thanks all — we want to keep momentum for the pilot while your procurement cycle completes. Happy to hop on a short call with AP if that helps.

Best,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Rebecca Lin <rebecca.lin@acme.com>, Alice Kim <alice.kim@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme procurement: next steps & security gating

- Week 0-2: Redwood provides SOC2 link + completed security questionnaire; Acme returns any DPA redlines.

Rebecca — happy to jump on a 20-min call with your AP team to confirm invoice layout if that helps avoid rework. Please advise and we�ll coordinate.
